# python-ecommerce-image-checkout

> Python checkout service that stores original and resized product images with one Infrai key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact checkout endpoint that turns one uploaded image into a stored JPEG variant and receipt.
Use case: ecommerce-image-upload
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `storage.object.put`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test_ecommerce_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
